import io.xberg.tslp.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() {

    val config = mapper.readValue("{\"language\":\"qmldir\"}", ProcessConfig::class.java)
    val result = TreeSitterLanguagePack.process("module Example", config)
    println(result)
}
